role.altitude: The emergency physician keeps asking about and watching pain, and deciding on analgesia and sedation; finding earlier scores and writing the sedation checklist shrink a little.
skills_to_grow: Using pain trends and structured sedation checklists
role.ambitious_version: An emergency physician who sees at a glance whose pain is not controlled and acts sooner.

tasks.short: Ask about and observe pain, review earlier pain scores and sedation history, assess patients' pain levels or sedation requirements and decide the plan, and record the assessment.

steps.what: Emergency physician asks the patient about pain and observes them
Emergency physician reviews pain scores and sedation history in the record
Emergency physician assesses pain levels or sedation requirements and decides the plan
Emergency physician records the assessment and the sedation checklist

tasks.design: Pain scores the nurses record at each round, and analgesics given, appear as a trend on the patient overview instead of in separate flowsheets. Asking, observing and deciding stay fully with the physician. The sedation checklist is a structured form in the record with fasting time, airway assessment and consent fields, filled where data already exist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Earlier scores and doses had to be found in separate screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Trend views and structured sedation forms in the record.
tasks.human_edge: Reading pain in a frightened child or a confused older patient.

evidence.claim: Rule-based medication checks cover interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates.
A prescription comes from a named practitioner; software does not prescribe.

assumptions: Boundary: assessing pain and sedation needs and deciding the plan; giving drugs is outside.
Input contract for s2: pain scores recorded by nurses at each round and medication administration records, as today.
Asking, observing and deciding keep their full time.
unknowns: How often pain scores are recorded.

incremental.description: Emergency physician checks prefilled checklist fields for accuracy.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few sedations; high: busy departments with frequent procedural sedation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
